model_claims.text: When adding an import via `add_imports`, a leading `isort: skip` import remains before the sorted block instead of being moved below it.
model_claims.source_quote: Insert ordinary additions after the leading skipped statements, using the complete statements already collected by the reader.

model_claims.text: Existing skip boundaries and newly added future imports retain their original positions after an import addition.
model_claims.source_quote: Keep existing skip boundaries and added future imports in their current positions.

model_claims.text: The tool recognizes the source's newline before inserting an addition, ensuring LF-to-CRLF conversion remains stable across repeated runs.
model_claims.source_quote: Recognize the source's newline before inserting an addition so LF-to-CRLF conversion stays stable on repeated runs.
